name: button
purpose: Triggers an action. Enhances a native <button>, keeping native semantics, form behavior, and keyboard activation.
whenToUse: Submitting forms or triggering in-page actions.
Icon-only actions that have an accessible name.
Actions with a busy state while an operation is pending.
whenNotToUse: Navigation to another page or URL: use a link (<a href>).
Toggling a persistent on/off state: use Switch.
Selecting one option among several: use a segmented control or radio group.
responsive: Inline-flex sizing; does not wrap its label. Minimum target size 1.5rem (WCAG 2.5.8). Density tokens adjust control height.
rtl: Uses logical properties; icon position start/end follows writing direction.
theme: All colors, sizes, radii and motion come from role tokens. Forced-colors mode uses system colors for borders and focus.
security: Text content is set via textContent (Button.create). No HTML parsing. CSP-safe: no inline styles or eval.
dataHandling: No persistence, network access, or telemetry.

performance.testedScale: 1,000 buttons on one page in the performance test.

limitations: Loading state blocks activation through a capture-phase click listener; consumer listeners added with capture on the same element before enhancement still run.
Icon-only buttons without text require `label`, aria-label or aria-labelledby; otherwise construction throws BUTTON_ICON_ONLY_LABEL.
unsupported: Rendering HTML strings as the button label.
antiPatterns: Using `disabled` for temporarily unavailable actions that users should still discover; prefer loading or an explanatory message.
Icon-only buttons without an accessible name.

adapters.angular: @absoluteui/angular/button: AuiButton directive (button[auiButton]), enhancing the native button in place.
